story_arceus_11_08000/2401_1101_100_20: Then, on the day of the Arceus Cup...
story_arceus_11_08000/2401_1001_100_10:
We didn’t make it through, but we put up
a good fight.
story_arceus_11_08000/2401_1001_200_10: We couldn’t awaken our arc suits...
story_arceus_11_08000/2401_1001_300_10:
Let’s start training so we’re acknowledged
next time!
story_arceus_11_08000/2401_1001_400_10:
But we’ve still got the biggest match to look
forward to!
story_arceus_11_08000/2401_1001_500_10: You two are up next! Are you ready?
story_arceus_11_08000/2401_1001_600_10: Heheh! ’Bout as ready as I can be!
story_arceus_11_08000/2401_1001_700_10: Do your best! Both of you!
story_arceus_11_08000/2401_1001_800_10:
Show us what you’re capable of after all
that training!
